name: Scenic Half Marathon Rayong (RSMH)
short_description: A half-marathon and 10km race held at Laem Charoen Public Park in Rayong, Thailand on August 2, 2026.
ai_summary: The Scenic Half Marathon Rayong (RSMH) is a half-marathon event organised by RACEUP WORK Co., Ltd. as part of the Scenic Marathon Series, scheduled for August 2, 2026, at Laem Charoen Public Park in Rayong, Thailand. Runners can choose between a 21.1km half marathon or a 10km distance.

core_facts.organizer: RACEUP WORK Co., Ltd. (Scenic Marathon Series)

pros: Coastal half marathon from Laem Charoen Public Park with a World Athletics Road Race Label
Nine water points on the 21.1 km route, with sports drink at 8, 13 and 17 km
3 hour 30 half-marathon limit; median finisher took 2:25:41 in 2026
Achievable top-ten and age-group places: tenth man ran 1:26:02 in 2026
cons: Saturated air at the 4.30am start: 28°C, 28°C dew point, 100% humidity in 2026
About ten kilometres of the course run inland, not along the beach
Roadworks on the coast road near 16 km in 2026
Entries are non-refundable, even if the race is cancelled, and non-transferable
research_highlights: The 2026 21.1 km course starts and finishes at Laem Charoen Public Park, heads west along the coast road, makes an inland loop with a turning point from about 4 km to 14 km, and returns along the coast past Saeng Chan beach.

The 2024 edition drew over 3,000 runners and was won by Ethiopia's Ebisa Takele in 1:07:50; the 2025 and 2026 overall titles went to Thai runners, and the organiser reported over 4,500 runners in 2026.
In 2026 the 21.1 km started at 4:30am and the 10 km at 5:00am, with cut-offs of 3 hours 30 minutes and 2 hours 30 minutes respectively.
The event is recognized as a World Athletics Label Road Race and is one leg of the multi-city 'Scenic Marathon Series' across Thai coastal/tourist provinces.
The 2026 race pack included a bib, T-shirt and finisher medal, plus a finisher shirt for the 21.1 km; the organiser provides group accident insurance for every registered runner.
research_watchouts: A YouTube video covering a past edition is titled 'Scenic Half Marathon Rayong วิ่งฝ่าลมชมทะเล ไม่ง่ายอย่างที่คิด' (roughly 'running against the wind by the sea, not as easy as you'd think'), suggesting coastal wind can make the flat route tougher than expected.
August in Rayong is peak tropical heat/humidity season in Thailand, which combined with the early cutoff for course support should be planned for.

No third-party running-community review sites (e.g., World's Marathons) had any submitted runner reviews at time of research, so most available coverage is organizer/sponsor press material rather than independent participant feedback.

faqs.question: When is the Scenic Half Marathon Rayong taking place?
faqs.answer: The Scenic Half Marathon Rayong, also known as RSMH, is scheduled to take place on August 2, 2026. The race is held at Laem Charoen Public Park in Rayong, Thailand, and is organized by the Scenic Marathon Series.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this event?
faqs.answer: The Scenic Half Marathon Rayong offers two distance options for participants: a 21.1km half marathon, which serves as the primary distance for the event, and a shorter 10km race. Both distances take place at Laem Charoen Public Park in Rayong, Thailand, on the same event day.

faqs.question: Who organizes the Scenic Half Marathon Rayong?
faqs.answer: The race is organised by RACEUP WORK Co., Ltd., which runs the Scenic Marathon Series of races across Thailand. The 2026 Rayong edition, the fifth, held World Athletics Road Race Label status for a second year and was followed in the series by Krabi, Chiang Mai and Nakhon Phanom.

faqs.question: Where is the race located?
faqs.answer: The Scenic Half Marathon Rayong is located at Laem Charoen Public Park in Rayong, Thailand. This venue hosts both the 21.1km half marathon and the 10km race distances offered by the event, which is organized by the Scenic Marathon Series and scheduled for August 2, 2026.
